briefing.headline: Soft landing intact as disinflation holds and jobs remain stable.

quotable_numbers.sentence: Core CPI at 2.6 percent for Sep 2026 sits near the Fed's target, allowing rates to stay measured.
Unemployment at 4.2 percent for Sep 2026 keeps the labor market resilient without overheating.

briefing.whats_new: Today: 10-Year Treasury firmer, from 4.94 percent to 4.95 percent.
